records.title: #YouAreWelcomeHere Scholarship
records.deadline_display: Institution Deadlines (typically in Spring or Summer 2027) - Students should complete a #YouAreWelcomeHere scholarship application for each selected institution by the institutions' deadline

source.publisher: NAFSA: Association of International Educators (#YouAreWelcomeHere campaign)
source.raw_extract:
Timeline

January 1, 2027 - Colleges and universities should confirm their participation in the academic year 2027 - 2028 scholarship campaign with NAFSA by submitting the sign-up form.

Institution Deadlines (typically in Spring or Summer 2027) - Students should complete a #YouAreWelcomeHere scholarship application for each selected institution by the institutions' deadline, including either an essay or multimedia submission explaining how they will apply their leadership skills in the campus community.

September 1, 2027 - Colleges and universities should notify NAFSA of their institution's scholarship recipients
source.exact_deadline_wording: Institution Deadlines (typically in Spring or Summer 2027)
source.notes: NAFSA, the campaign owner, publishes no single calendar deadline: the deadline is set by each participating institution. It publishes only a window ('typically in Spring or Summer 2027'), which supports MONTH semantics with deadline_date null. The page also states 'Applicant meets the admission criteria and adhere to the deadlines at each college or university. Details will vary from school to school.' No day may be invented, and one institution's deadline must not be used for the campaign.

Per the brief, another programme's deadline and a generic index of other programmes may not be used, so evidence is insufficient. records.title: Copenhagen Business School Danish Government Scholarship

source.raw_extract:
You can apply for the double degree option in the first semester of your MSc programme. There are some criteria you will have to fullfill to apply. A selection of candidates will be invited to an interview as part of the selection process.

You can find all information and details on my.cbs.dk (CBS login required) when you are admitted to your CBS programme.
source.notes: The record's official_source_url (CBS Double Degree) contains no mention of the Danish Government Scholarship and no deadline of any kind; it defers admissions detail to a login-gated student portal. No official cbs.dk page publishing a Danish Government Scholarship deadline was found. The record's cached display '15 January 2026 (Round 1) / 15 October 2026 (Round 2)' and its cached application_period ('Other deadlines apply for CBS Students taking elective or mandatory courses. Please see Summer University on my.cbs.dk.') both trace to the Summer University course-application page, which is a different programme (short summer courses, not the master's Danish Government Scholarship), and even that page no longer shows those dates - its current window is '26 January at 12:00 CET - 13 April at 12:00 CEST' for summer 2027. Third-party aggregators surfaced by search gave mutually inconsistent CBS rounds (15 January/15 October vs 1 February) but were not fetched and are not official sources, so this is recorded as UNKNOWN rather than CONFLICTING.

source.raw_extract:
To apply for the scholarship, follow these steps:

Apply for one of our master's programmes through University Admissions as your first priority. Make sure to pay the application fee to University Admissions.
Admitted students will receive more information on how to apply for the scholarship after Notification of Selection Results.
Scholarship selection will be based on previous academic excellence, the experience described in your CV, and your ability to motivate social engagement through your chosen programme at Malmö University.
Applicants who have been offered a scholarship will be notified by the end of April. Those who are not offered a scholarship will not be notified individually.

Please note

Only a few students are granted scholarships every year. You should, therefore, start planning for ways to finance your tuition and stay in Sweden well in advance, in case you are not awarded a scholarship. The deadline to pay tuition fees is 10 May.
source.notes: The official Malmö University page for this scholarship publishes no application deadline. The scholarship application is not applied for at a published fixed date: applicants must have applied in the first admissions round via University Admissions, and 'Admitted students will receive more information on how to apply for the scholarship after Notification of Selection Results.' The only two calendar statements on the page are not deadlines for this scholarship: award notification 'by the end of April' (an outcome notification, not an application deadline) and 'The deadline to pay tuition fees is 10 May' (the tuition-fee payment milestone for admitted students, a different milestone). The record's cached display 'to pay tuition fees is 10 May.' misattributes that tuition-fee milestone to the scholarship and was NOT used as evidence; using it would be the prohibited 'generic admissions deadline for a different programme'.
